comment: Measurements this table carries that scripts/build_hazards.py cannot derive from the round-three report. The builder applies them after the main build, slow winning over fast, so regenerating keeps them instead of silently restoring the weaker verdict each one corrects.

sources.note: One row does not come from unit e3's per-pattern witness sweep. e3 built each witness from the pattern's own parse tree, so no witness it generated for ATR-2026-02351 crossed. Replaying e3's 294 recorded crossing templates against every admitted rule found it on the template generated for ATR-2026-00106: 1.04s at 16KB, 3.67s at 32KB, 15.52s at 64KB, 70.71s at 128KB, a clean factor of four per doubling. A per-pattern witness search generalises poorly across patterns; the table's build step owes a full cross-replay sweep, which has not been run.

Closes the CFG-configuration-channel measurement gap: unit e3 (above) timed each rule's *composed* pattern; agent_defs/cfg.py's _CompiledBinding screens each rule's *individual* conditions one at a time (require_measurement=True as of 2026-09-05), and 1,203 distinct condition strings extracted by scripts/extract_unmeasured.py from the same pinned ATR checkout (faf743fee8a5018467959ec8ea7ccdb1a1aab333) had no row at that granularity. Measured on spark-37f2 (CPython 3.12.3, Linux-6.17.0-1014-nvidia-aarch64) on 2026-09-05 with the unmodified e3_empirical.py harness (same method as this table's other rows: adversarial witness built from each pattern's own parse tree, LENGTHS=[16,31,64,256,1024,4096,16384,65536,262144], 1.10 s discovery cap, 62 s confirmation cap to 1 MiB, one killable subprocess per attempt, budget_s=1.0 matching this table's top-level budget_s): `python3 e3_empirical.py discovery --workers 20` then `python3 e3_empirical.py confirmation --workers 20`, against an extracted.json built from unmeasured-cfg.json with pattern_id set to its own 16-hex fingerprint. Result: 1085 fast, 118 slow (92 of the slow also over 60 s), 0 compile errors, 0 patterns left unmeasured. Additive only: every new key is a fingerprint absent from the table before this sweep (verified, 0 overlap with the existing 2,542); no existing row was overwritten; the cross_pattern_replay row for atr:ATR-2026-02351 above is untouched (its pattern is not among these 1,203); the "rules" dict is untouched (this sweep measures individual conditions, which only the CFG channel's own per-condition screen consults, not the whole-rule digest evaluate.measurement_for_rule reads).

Times the strings this loader derives rather than labelling them from their origin's verdict. A rule that never crossed had its own conditions measured, but the surrogate port rewrites the expression and the scoped alternation composes several of them, and unit e3 found composition is exactly where a rule that looks fast crosses. Until this sweep those derived strings carried the origin's fast row, which is the inference least entitled to be made. The 707 strings screened by agent_defs.loaders.atr and agent_defs.cfg that had no row of their own were timed on spark-37f2 (CPython 3.12.3, Linux aarch64) on 2026-09-05 with the unmodified research/efficacy-2026-09-05/scripts/e3_empirical.py: same method as this table's other rows, LENGTHS to 262144 with confirmation to 1 MiB, 1.10 s discovery cap, 62 s confirmation cap, budget_s=1.0, one killable subprocess per attempt. `python3 e3_empirical.py discovery --workers 20` then `confirmation --workers 20`. 484 fast, 218 slow, 5 left unmeasured because they do not compile under Python re, which the screen refuses on its own.
